This decline was attributed to flat portfolio revaluations of 0.1%, negatively impacted by KinderCare Learning Companies' share price performance, and a 0.5% drag from currency movements. The company invested EUR 2.6 million during the month in Sports Entertainment Group, becoming its largest outside shareholder, and noted continued strong performance from investments like Rosen Group and MPM Products. Disclaimer* Partners Group Private Equity Ltd 09 October 2026 (LSE: PEY) Partners Group Private Equity Limited NAV per share decreased by 0.5% in August · NAV decreased to EUR 11.53 per share, corresponding to EUR 765.12 million · Flat portfolio revaluations (+0.1%) after impact from KinderCare Learning Companies ("KinderCare") while negative currency movements (-0.5%) dragged on overall performance · PGPE Ltd invested EUR 2.6 million during the month The portfolio revaluations were impacted by the listed share price performance of KinderCare, the largest for-profit provider of early childhood education and care services in the US. The company recently reported its second quarter financial results, which reflected lower enrollment partially offset by contributions from newer centers and tuition increases. Partners Group continues to work closely with the KinderCare board and management team to boost occupancy and drive expansion. Meanwhile, younger vintages remain an important source of value creation for the portfolio, with investments such as Rosen Group, a global leader in mission-critical inspection services and integrity management solutions for energy infrastructure assets, and MPM Products, a UK-based premium pet food company, continuing to perform well. In August, Partners Group, on behalf of its clients, invested in Sports Entertainment Group ("SEG"), becoming its largest outside shareholder. SEG is an international sports talent agency representing more than 1'000 athletes and artists across football, cycling, gaming and music through a network of approximately 200 agents and staff in 40 countries. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Amsterdam, the company has benefited from growing demand for talent representation as athletes increasingly generate income through endorsements, image rights and direct audience engagement, supporting net revenue growth of approximately 40% annually over the past three years. Partners Group intends to support SEG's continued growth through targeted acquisitions, expansion into additional sports and adjacent services, and enhanced commercial partnership and brand development capabilities. The investment by PGPE Ltd in SEG was EUR 2.6 million. PGPE Ltd has made available the recording of its latest investor update webcast. The recording is available on the Investors - Results & Presentations section of the Company's website . Ends. About Partners Group Private Equity Limited PGPE Ltd is an investment holding company founded in 1999 and domiciled in Guernsey. It invests in private equity direct investments. PGPE Ltd is managed in its investment activities by Partners Group, one of the largest firms in the global private markets industry, with USD 186 billion in investment programs under management in private markets, of which USD 79 billion is in private equity. Partners Group itself is listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (ticker: PGHN). PGPE Ltd aims to provide shareholders with long-term capital growth and an attractive dividend yield. PGPE Ltd is traded on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange (ticker: PEY).
